title: Billing enforcement schedule and sales readiness for pricing reshape
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: Coordinate the final launch activities for the upcoming pricing/packaging change with emphasis on how billing enforcement (limits, quota checks, overage billing) rolls out to cohorts, and ensure Sales + Support are enabled with correct collateral and runbooks. This ticket centralizes release notes snippets, enforcement windows, telemetry gating, rollback triggers, and customer communication cadence.

Scope:
- Finalize SKU-to-meter mapping and enforcement schedule for hosted API and Dedicated customers.
- Approve billing migration communications for invoices and usage dashboards.
- Coordinate release notes (public and internal) and staggered rollout cohorts.
- Sales enablement: training deck, objection handling cheatsheet, and account migration playbook.
- Support readiness: triage runbook, KB articles, and escalation paths.

Out of scope: billing system code changes (owned by ENG-Billing), legal contract renegotiations, and rate negotiations for enterprise customers (handled by AE team).
checklist: Confirm final SKU definitions and mapping table loaded to billing service (ENG-5499 PR #4321)
Lock rate card values in pricing spreadsheet and export to catalog.json for runtime (PM > Finance sign-off)
Publish public release notes draft and internal release notes with technical appendices
Define enforcement windows and flags for soft vs hard limit behavior per cohort
Create customer cohorts: beta (5% traffic), staged (25%), general availability
Produce Sales enablement deck and record 45min walkthrough session
Create Support runbook and add KB articles to Help Center
Approve billing notification wording and invoice examples
Schedule observability dashboards and SLO error budget alerts for first 72 hours
Prepare rollback criteria and emergency mitigation steps
